text:
maria: Heads up — customer can't redeem promo/trial. Flow requires card-on-file; tokenization times out and the grant never goes through. Customer id: 10093, EU region. Anyone seeing spikes?
ryan: Thanks — can you paste the payment error and gateway? cc @billing-bot
maria: Paste from support logs: payment_intent create -> status 'requires_action' -> redirect to 3DS, but our tokenization times out before auth result. Stripe confirm step fails with a timeout. Request id req_01Gxyz
```
POST /v1/payment_intents
{
  "amount": 0,
  "currency": "usd",
  "payment_method": "pm_card_visa",
  "confirm": true,
  "return_url": "https://app.redwood/checkout/return"
}
Error: stripe.confirmation.timeout
```
support-engineer: Is this only sandbox or prod? Any quick repro steps?
maria: Prod. User clicked the 3DS challenge, was redirected back to our /tokenize callback but the callback returned HTTP 504 from our side — webhook didn't get payment_intent.succeeded. Support retried but grant path requires tokenization completion, so trial blocked.
billing-bot: Auto-created ticket INC-6209. Linked Stripe logs: https://dashboard.stripe.com/logs/req_01Gxyz :warning:
ryan: Can you try reproduce with a direct confirm curl and capture network logs? Could be issuer timeout or our redirect timing out. We saw a 504 on /tokenize at 2026-03-12T10:24:23Z (EU).
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/payments/confirm \
-d "payment_intent=pi_1Gxyz" \
-H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED"
```
callum: We had elevated latency in EU gateway 10:20-10:25 — infra alert fired. CDN origin had transient failures, adding ~10-12s to redirect roundtrip which can trigger client-side timeouts for some issuers.
sophie: Support can manually grant the trial credits as a bandaid. What's the safe internal path? Customer is blocked right now.
maria: On call with customer — manual grant workflow I used: `POST /internal/grants` with {customer_id, promo_code, amount, reason}. Need billing approval and audit note.
ryan: I'll extend the webhook handshake timeout and add extra idempotent guards so late 3DS callbacks still result in a grant. @stripe-bot can you pull events for pi_1Gxyz?
stripe-bot: Attached Stripe events for pi_1Gxyz: `payment_intent.succeeded` at 2026-03-12T10:24:30Z. Forward to our webhook once; our endpoint returned 504. Event details: requires_action -> succeeded.
maria: Patch looks good. I've manually issued the trial credits and added audit note referencing INC-6209. Follow-ups: increase client-side redirect timeout, and consider a feature flag to bypass preauth for $0 trial flows.
ryan: Action list: (1) INC-6209 — extend retry window + idempotency check, (2) infra: investigate CDN origin flapping (callum), (3) support: manual credits for affected customers (sophie). We'll do a short postmortem if this recurs. :thumbsup:
